description: This file defines the OAuthAccessToken class representing an OAuth 2.0 access token within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for token details such as ID, token string, associated client and user IDs, expiry date, and revoked status. It also provides getter and setter methods for these properties, managing their access and modification. The class is mapped to the database table 'ohrm_oauth2_access_token' using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: OAuthAccessToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth 2.0 access token, including its properties and database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the access token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the access token.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time in UTC as a DateTimeImmutable object.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time of the token.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Returns whether the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
